value.rationale: The new quasinecklace family is used in colex generators, including bounded-weight generation. An explicit finite fixed-content count, the sharp 1/m coefficient and the first exact weight-three failure identify how many false candidates the generator filters, improving a constant-factor guarantee to asymptotic optimality for each fixed content. This is a natural output-sensitive efficiency statistic, not an arbitrary slice.
